## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `dca788103c73e096fb73db0a0ed3fbc110b73451`
Local-runs: probe — the seat ran, in a detached read-only worktree of the head (no edit, no network): `node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test` → ✓ 297 cases, `node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs --self-test` → ✓ 49 cases / 8 batteries, `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` → ✓, `check-skill-id-lint.mjs` → ✓ 104 clean, `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test` → ✓ 401, `check-half-states.mjs --self-test` → ✓ 5034; the live read-only mode of the new script was NOT run by the seat (the dev ran it once: 22 open PRs read, 16 owe a review, exit 0)
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md (L23–28 new, old L54 removed, L60 reworded), references/triage-duties.md (L11, L12, L16 in place), scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs (`readContractReviewClaim`, `contractReviewClaimLapse`, `contractReviewClaims`, the claim battery, the widened `self-test-reads` declaration), scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs (new, report-only), scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs (`GOVERNED_READ_FLOOR` sixth row), package.json (`check:pm-record-recognisers` chains the new self-test) + card #27062's 「Wanted」 1–6 as amended (ruling 6460017532; amendment 6468887030 on the maintainer's words)

Read at 2026-10-28T15:05Z by the `domain:skills#2` seat on the fetched head (merge-base `0d45c0e7`): six files, +825/−11, 836 changed lines ≤ 3000 (`check-governed-merges --pr 27295`: two `.claude` paths, Tier S; `package.json` and `scripts/pm/**` off the register). The claim's tier was the default (no path mandate); this review is served at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.

### ① Derived judgments

- Items 2–3 (contract-review.md L23–28, each ≤120 B, the file now exactly at its ceiling 60/60): triage takes only an owed PR — draft or ready (the amendment) — whose current head has no record and no live claim, under one of (a) a hand-off naming the current head OR the waiting label, taken the same round; (b) the head has waited one full triage round (~60 min); (c) the lane seat has stood down or is absent from the roster; the owed list is `node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs`, read-only. Before any review, lane or triage reads the PR: a record or a live claim on the current head ⇒ ⛔ do not start; else post the claim line first, one per head — `Contract-review-claim: <session> · head <full sha> · <UTC>` — lapsing when the head moves or 2 h after posting with no record; a tie on one head ⇒ the lane wins, triage replies once to withdraw and discards its output. That is the card's 2–3 verbatim in the file's register. The deleted L54 (「只带标记无交接行者仍归本席,分诊 ⛔ 不碰…」) was made false by the amendment (the label alone is now trigger (a)) — its surviving content (a hand-off must name the current head; a moved head needs a new one or the lane's own review) lives in (a) and in the lapse line. L60 drops 「巡查脚本」 from the no-reader list honestly (the owed-review script does read the label) and adds 认领行 to what no check, workflow or queue guard reads (item 4). Holds.
- Item 6 (triage-duties L11/L12/L16, in place, 115/118/120 B, 102/102): each round first runs the owed-review script (open PRs including drafts, reading hand-off AND claim lines) and takes owed reviews in the same round after claiming; the isolated at-tier subagent and the never-downgrade rule kept; item 5: the round record names the claimer per head (`认领者 · 记录 head→现 head→状态`). The dropped clause (「交接行读法 record-recognisers.mjs」) lives in the script, which reads hand-offs through that module. Holds.
- Item 4 (record-recognisers.mjs): `readContractReviewClaim` returns the hand-off reader's state shape (`missing` / `unreadable` / `read {session, head, time, at}`) — better than the order's `{…} | null` sketch because an unreadable claim must be reportable; `contractReviewClaimLapse` (head moved, or `> 2 h` with no record — the dev's ablation of `>=`→`>` and of the tie holder each turned exactly one case red) and `contractReviewClaims(rows, headSha)` (live claims, holder = the lane's when both exist). All read through `stripSignatureLine` like every reader since PR #27263; the battery (21 cases, floor 21) pins the template and the 2-hour lapse verbatim in contract-review.md, so text and reader cannot drift — the governed read is DECLARED (the `self-test-reads` line names both files; `GOVERNED_READ_FLOOR` gains its sixth row; the census needed no change: same line). Holds.
- The owed-review script (`check-owed-reviews.mjs`, 602 lines, report-only): lists every open PR whose face owes a review with the record, hand-off, claim, lane seat and a `TAKE / WAIT / HELD / DONE` status and the trigger; it REUSES `reviewFace`, `readClause2Line`, `locateReviewOfRecord`, `contractReviewHandoff` and fleet-roster's `parseSeat` (no second implementation of the owed face); exits 0 on any completed or failed read (a failed read prints `sweep INCOMPLETE`), 2 only on a malformed command line, 1 only from `--self-test` — ⛔ not a gate. Its self-test models the two Tier H drafts the ui seat named (hand-off on the current head; hand-off renewed after a merge-forward): both `TAKE` under (a), `HELD` once a triage claim is posted. Wiring: no workflow line — the self-test runs inside the existing `lint.yml` step through `package.json`'s `check:pm-record-recognisers` chain; `check:self-test-wired` green (244 scripts). Holds; the order's "exit 0 always" is correctly refined.

### ② Semver level

- None owed: protocol text, PM scripts, a root `package.json` script string; no package touched. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body match the claim; no `Skills-docs:` line owed; `skip-changeset` correct (`dependencies` is the labeler's reading of `package.json`, not a dependency change — the diff is one script string).

### ③ Boundary flags

- Four derived families NOT MEASURED locally (`check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` — prerequisite: a full build, triggered by the root `package.json` touch); the diff changes one script string, no package; CI's lanes carry them — read off the head's check-runs in the ACCEPT.
- The `lint.yml` step comment still describes one self-test file — Tier H, left alone; the chain is in `package.json`. Noted.
- Three Acceptance-note observations, agreed and carried: `dispatch-runbook.md` 〈巡查常设项〉 L44–45 still tells a cross-account reviewer to post a `Claim:`-shaped comment before reviewing — now a second spelling of the review claim (a later card; that file is held by another claim this wave); the 〈等复核标记〉 interaction (a lane seat that will review its own PR posts its claim with or before the label, else triage takes it the same round — this is the rule working, and the lane's own records are posted at ACCEPT anyway); trigger (b) times the head from the later of committer date and PR `created_at` (REST carries no push time — a force-pushed old commit can look older than it is).
- Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay; `mcp_calls: 0`; the report comment carries the signature; draft, no flip by anyone.

### ④ Design judgment

- Against the maintainer's words (the lane reviews its own; triage only where nobody is reviewing; how to avoid duplicate reviews; "they had told you"): the gap is now defined by three mechanical triggers rather than one line, drafts are no longer invisible, the owed list is a script anyone runs rather than a session's memory, and two reviewers cannot start on one head because the first posts a claim that the second reads — with the lane winning any tie. Against the four-axis frame: focus (no gate, no workflow, one script chained into an existing step), AI-error (the claim template and lapse pinned in both text and reader; refusal to start, not tolerance), long-run (one owed-face function reused, one claim reader beside the hand-off reader). Holds. Residual: the second `Claim:` spelling in dispatch-runbook (noted above) and the roster-absence trigger (c), which depends on the roster being current.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-27062-contract-review-ownership`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读 — 席位终稿 · PR #27295 · head `dca78810` · `domain:skills#2` · 2026-10-28T15:19Z

- 改了什么:把「谁复核这个 PR」从一句话变成可执行的三件:① 分诊只接「无人在复核」的 PR —— 现 head 无记录、无在生认领,且三触发之一成立(交接行点名现 head 或挂了等复核标记;head 等满一轮约 60 分钟;车道席已收班或不在名单),草稿 PR 也算(按你的话改的范围);② 复核前先贴一行认领 `Contract-review-claim: <session> · head <sha> · <UTC>`,一 head 一行,head 一动或 2 小时无记录即失效,撞车车道胜、分诊撤;③ 新脚本 `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` 只读列出所有欠复核的开 PR(含草稿)与 TAKE/WAIT/HELD/DONE 状态,分诊每轮开局先跑它。读法进 record-recognisers(自测 297 例,新增认领行 21 例),欠单脚本自测 49 例挂进现有 lint 链;无新门禁、无 workflow 改动。
- 为什么改:你的原话「车道自己复核自己的,分诊只复核没人复核的」「怎么避免重复复核」「他们早告诉你了」—— 两张 Tier H 草稿等了数小时无人接,因为草稿不在分诊视野、「没人复核」只凭会话记忆判;本 PR 让空档由三个机械触发定义、欠单由脚本列、两席不可能同时起手。
- 风险与回滚:协议文本两文件 + PM 只读脚本;脚本任何读失败都 exit 0(报 sweep INCOMPLETE),不是门;回滚 = revert 两个 commit。
- 先看:contract-review.md L23–28(触发与认领行模板,60/60);triage-duties L11/L12/L16(102/102);record-recognisers.mjs 的 `readContractReviewClaim` / `contractReviewClaimLapse` / `contractReviewClaims`。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` 列出当前欠复核的 PR;`node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test` 297 绿;`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` 两文件 headroom 0。
- 需要你做的:无 —— Tier S(两条 `.claude` 路径;`scripts/pm/**` 与 `package.json` 不在受管名单),契约复核 PASS(6472602303)后席位按你今天的落地授权落地。
- 席位意见:ACCEPT。六文件逐一读过;新脚本复用既有「欠复核面」函数而非第二套实现;认领模板与 2 小时失效在文本与读法两处同钉(自测消融各翻红一例);三条范围外观察实属后续卡,记 Acceptance notes。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:skills#2` · `session_01QSeKYmhU5KEj1nukYhp1Tg` · 2026-10-28T15:19Z

1. 形态:draft → main,首行 `Fixes #27062`,`Clause-②: no`、`Metadata-protocol: none` 行首在;六文件 +825/−11(836 行 ≤ 3000);assignee os-justin;`skip-changeset` 正确(`dependencies` 是 labeler 对 package.json 的读法,diff 只改一条脚本串,无依赖变动);两 commit;作者 `objectstack-fleet[bot]` 经中继,`mcp_calls: 0`;dev 报告首行带署名(6472536326)。
2. 前提实测:席位在取回的 head(merge-base `0d45c0e7`)上的 detached worktree 复跑 —— record-recognisers 自测 297 ✓、check-owed-reviews 自测 49 ✓、ratchet ✓(contract-review 60/60、triage-duties 102/102)、id-lint ✓、queue-guard 自测 401 ✓、half-states 自测 5034 ✓;新 `.claude` 行每行 ≤120 B;package.json 链 `check:pm-record-recognisers` 串入新自测;`GOVERNED_READ_FLOOR` 第六行在;`check-governed-merges --pr 27295` ⇒ Tier S。范围按分诊改单 6468887030(草稿纳入)核对,与卡 Wanted 1–6 逐条对上(复核记录 6472602303 ①)。
3. 门禁 check-runs(head `dca78810`,本笔读数 2026-10-28T15:19Z):47 check-runs,28 success · 19 skipped · 0 in progress · 0 failure;19 个 skip 由 `check-expected-skips.mjs --check-runs-json`(在 origin/main `b4458075` 的名单上)判定全部在册,exit 0;四族构建派生门(dts-closure / dual-build / lean-entry / sourcemap)席位未本地测,由 CI 的 Lint · Build Core 等 lane 承担,皆绿。
4. 接受的偏差:① `readContractReviewClaim` 返回 missing/unreadable/read 三态而非令中的 `{…}|null` 草图(不可读的认领必须可报);② 脚本退出码细化为「读失败 exit 0 + sweep INCOMPLETE、用法错 exit 2、自测红 exit 1」,仍非门;③ 触发 (b) 的 head 时点取 committer date 与 PR created_at 的较晚者(REST 无推送时间);④ dev 推翻了我「reconcile-list 可复用」的假设,实测无此面;⑤ 脚本活读模式席位未亲跑(dev 跑过一次:22 开 PR,16 欠)。
5. 范围外去向:none filed;Acceptance notes 三条留后续卡:dispatch-runbook 〈巡查常设项〉L44–45 仍叫跨账号复核者先贴 `Claim:` 形评论,成了复核认领的第二拼法(该文件本波另有认领在手,不并入);〈等复核标记〉与本认领行的互动(车道要自审则先于或同笔贴认领,否则分诊同轮可接 —— 即规则本意);lint.yml 步骤注释仍写单一自测文件(Tier H,不动,链在 package.json)。`Skills-docs:` 不欠(kind none)。
6. 落地条款:Tier S;契约复核 PASS 评论 6472602303(head `dca78810`);全绿即席位经中继 `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` 落地(本班维护者「你应该按照 pm-dispatch 技能审核并落地pr」在案);MERGED 后关卡摘 `pm:dispatched`;`triage-duties.md` 热文件队列放开 → #27061(本班不再派发,留队列无 assignee)。
